data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 3116 (commit 6080140e7af; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, no advisories). make verify before the push: 17 failed, 19745 passed, 107 skipped; all 17 failures are the known pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, 0 elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines.

Premise checked first: the 2026-09-21 Windows job log (run 35551741150, job 106187634058) ends this test with SshKeygenUnavailable: ssh-keygen (OpenSSH) not found; SSHSIG requires OpenSSH >= 8.9, so the ticket's cause holds.

Change (tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py only): _skip_without_sshsig() calls sshsig.ensure_available() and turns only SshKeygenUnavailable into pytest.skip, with a reason that names the version and the 8.9 floor and says per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted. It is called first in test_opcert_signing_key_is_isolated_per_store and, after its existing POSIX-mode skip (reason citing 47d8-baf8-2348-45c9, unchanged), in test_copied_opcert_signing_keys_are_owner_only. No module-level skip. 5 helper tests pin it: skips for a missing ssh, 8.8 and 7.9; does not skip at 8.9; lets any other exception through.

Evidence. Shim = an executable named ssh first on PATH whose banner is OpenSSH_8.8p1, OpenSSL 3.0.2.
1. Isolation module under the shim, BEFORE: 2 failed, 12 passed (the two tests above fail with SshKeygenUnavailable, the Windows failure reproduced on macOS). AFTER (2026-10-25 22:04 PDT): 17 passed, 2 skipped, reason 'OpenSSH 8.8 is too old for SSHSIG; requires >= 8.9; per-store opcert key isolation is not asserted here'. The 17 are the 12 unchanged tests plus the 5 helper tests.
2. Real ssh (OpenSSH 10.3) after: 19 passed (14 original + 5 new).
3. Merged main (HEAD 6080140e7af), 2026-10-25 23:43 PDT: 8.8 shim -> 17 passed, 2 skipped; real ssh -> 19 passed.
Note on the plan's wording: the acceptance criteria said '14 passed' and '12 passing in both'; with the 5 helper tests added the real counts are 19 passed (real ssh) and 17 passed plus 2 skipped (8.8 shim). The 12 unchanged tests pass in both runs.
4. Only tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py changed for this ticket.

Scope: the same condition fails 46 more tests in 4 other modules on the Windows sweep (measured with the 8.8 shim: 50 of 97 across 5 modules). Those are tracked in coldwater-dermoid-rattail (4803-05ae-23bc-4403), whose probe fix landed as 3115; after it the 5 modules pass under a Windows-banner shim. Unverified: the real Windows runner's behaviour; this host is macOS. The skip stays as the fallback for a runner without OpenSSH 8.9.
